original_card.question: Can one measured replay bottleneck be sped up without dropping coverage?
methods: Profile one isolated replay and optimize the measured bottleneck.
Design source-bound reuse with explicit dependency invalidation and negative controls.

Expertise override selected verifier-engineering after profiling leave-alone production rewrites (#2357/#2375/#2409 and the pending HPE-transport sibling) and remaining proved opt-in adapters. stop_rule: Stop after wiring one production object with identical-receipt evidence, pin-drift demotions, and a descriptive before/after wall-time sample; do not invent kappa or reopen leave-alone objects.
